description: A script for truncating a JSON-formatted NetLog file by removing the oldest events to reduce file size, with command-line interface and size parsing.

methods.name: get_file_size
methods.description: Returns the filesize of a given file path in bytes.

methods.name: truncate_log_file
methods.description: Copies input log file to output, truncating oldest events to match desired size.

methods.name: parse_filesize_str
methods.description: Parses a human-readable size string into a byte value.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling argument parsing and executing truncation.
